description: Mode manifest. Each mode declares which step files participate in its flow, its mode-level constraints, and per-entry overrides that collapse shared enum entries (mode, variant) to mode-specific subsets. UI/tools reconstruct a per-mode hyperparameter view by union'ing the `includes` files in order, then applying `overrides` per matching `key`.

modeA_single.description: Mode A single-subject personalisation against a pre-staged group prior (K=1; runs step 0/1/3)

num_subjects.note: Mode A single requires exactly 1 subject

modeA_batch.description: Mode A batch personalisation against a pre-staged group prior (K>=1; runs step 0/1/3 per subject)

num_subjects.note: Mode A batch supports any K>=1 subjects

modeB_train_prior.description: Mode B coupled-EM training of a cohort-specific group prior (K>=2; runs step 0/1/2/3; cMSHBM excluded)

num_subjects.note: Mode B requires K>=2 - coupled EM needs a cohort

constraints.cMSHBM_excluded_reason: step2 has no xyz-vMF path in the master kernel; Step2Config raises NotImplementedError on cMSHBM (Step2Config.__post_init__ in step2_pipeline/config.py)

variant.description: Pipeline variant. cMSHBM is EXCLUDED in Mode B because step2 has no xyz-vMF path in the master kernel; Step2Config raises NotImplementedError on cMSHBM (Step2Config.__post_init__ in step2_pipeline/config.py).
